rules.sentence: The differential diagnosis of the IBD subtypes UC and CD has significant importance for the choice of the clinical treatment and surgical options that would be appropriate for any given patient with IBD.

The differential diagnosis of the IBD subtypes UC and CD has significant importance for the choice of the clinical treatment and surgical options that would be appropriate for any given patient with IBD.
The morbidity of IBD has been steadily increasing, involving more than 6.8 million people globally, at a cost of approximately $23,000 per patient per year.
In about 10–15% of the cases, the differentiation between UC and CD is not possible or one condition may be misdiagnosed for the other.
